sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Replace the unsupported math:sqrt(?yield) calls with a formula encoding supported by the deterministic evaluator. The evaluator registers only the specified XPath math IRIs for trigonometry and does not support math:sqrt; preserve the same lower-bound comparison, C=805/282 branch logic, 9 mm bound, and (netShellPlatingThickness-corrosionAbrasionAddition)/2 bound.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Add sh:maxCount 1 to nltl:inLieuOfFrame and to nltl:frameProfileType. The current sh:or permits conflicting true/false selector values and simultaneous profileSection/flatBarSection values; this can satisfy alternative branches non-exclusively and apply the incorrect C=805 profile formula to a flat-bar case. Preserve the existing branch-specific required profile selection for inLieuOfFrame=false.

Retain the now-correct sh:maxCount 1 constraints for nltl:inLieuOfFrame and nltl:frameProfileType, but add the missing formula-derived lower-bound check. The constraint must reject nltl:frameWebThickness values below nltl:adjacentFrameHeight * sqrt(nltl:yieldStrength) / C, using C=805 when nltl:inLieuOfFrame is true or when the false branch selects nltl:profileSection, and C=282 when the false branch selects nltl:flatBarSection. Preserve the existing 9 mm inclusive lower bound and shell-minus-addition half-thickness check so thickness is constrained to the maximum of all three required bounds.

Replace the unsupported math:sqrt(?yield) calls with a formula encoding supported by the deterministic evaluator. The evaluator registers only the specified XPath math IRIs for trigonometry and does not support math:sqrt; preserve the same lower-bound comparison, C=805/282 branch logic, 9 mm bound, and (netShellPlatingThickness-corrosionAbrasionAddition)/2 bound.
